entities.name: Loras Joseph Watters
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Loras Joseph Watters was an American bishop of the Catholic Church. He served as an auxiliary bishop in the Archdiocese of Dubuque in Iowa from 1965 to 1969, and as the fifth bishop of Winona in Minnesota from 1969 to 1986.
